title: A/R: a payment reversed later still counts on the earlier date
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer X has a $100.00 invoice paid in full on day P.
  • That payment was reversed on day R, later than P (both past days).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Set the date chip to a day between P and R.
  4. Open every bucket.
  5. Look for the invoice.
  6. Set the date chip to day R.
  7. Open every bucket.
  8. Look for the invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • the invoice is not listed (it was paid on that day).

Step 8:

  • the invoice is listed with Open balance $100.00.

Why this matters: Historic reports must not change when a payment is reversed later.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Customer/Customers/Infrastructure/Doctrine/CustomerAccount/OpenBalanceAsOfSql.php:186-193. V1 code, quoted: `AND (cp.reversed_at IS NULL OR cp.reversed_at > :asOfDate)`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-021) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
